_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/s17-one-approval-one-action.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-21 (unattended run 9), from the spec's own numbered acceptance criteria.

features.description: Two tool calls in one response sharing an id raise before any tool is invoked.
Two tool calls in one response that carry no usable id - None or empty string - are refused the same way, and neither runs.
A single call carrying no id is unchanged (control for 2).
Ids differing only by case or whitespace are two answerable calls and both execute (control).
The colliding assistant message never enters the transcript.
The refusal is identical in the streamed loop.
A response whose ids are all distinct executes exactly as today (control).
A single call, gated or ungated, is unchanged (control).
A stored transcript carrying an indistinguishable assistant turn is refused at resume, and the tool does not run.
A stored transcript with distinct ids resumes exactly as today (control).
The refusal, on both the forward and the resume path, names no platform, vendor or model.
The evals runner can express an expected refusal, fails a wrong one, still fails an unexpected raise, and applies absent_text to the refusal text.
resume_run's answer contract is unchanged: no web-app change is required.
